tips.text: This is the goal: every line of the flight checklist passing, so the ship can lift off. A cross is a line still open.
You have parts on hand that close two of those lines. Tap Build to fit them.
These are the parts on hand. Tap the ringed one: the checklist needs it.
Now tap the grid where it goes. It shows as a ghost first, red if it can't go there. Tap the ghost again to put it down.
Everything on hand that the checklist needs is fitted. Tap Hangar to go back.
The engines have to be earned or bought. Jobs pay credits, and sometimes a part. Tap Jobs.
Each job says what it pays, who you'll face and any twist. Pick one, then tap Take the job.
Your crew. Tap one to give them orders: two actions a turn each.
Tap a tile to see the move and the cover where it ends. Tap it again to go.
Tap an enemy, or Shoot, to see the odds. Fire takes the shot, and ends that crew member's turn.
When the crew is done, End turn hands it to the enemy. A turn also ends once nobody has an action left.
